title: Adding Error Bars to Evals: A Statistical Approach to Language Model Evaluations
one_line_what_it_does: Treats eval items as draws from a super-population; gives cluster-robust SEs, paired model-difference inference, variance reduction and power/minimum-detectable-effect formulas for comparing two models
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Whole inferential recipe (cluster SE + paired difference + power) for model comparison on benchmarks; item-level, no CV, no few-cluster correction, no domain specifics

title: Statistical inference on representational geometries
one_line_what_it_does: Cross-validated 2-factor (subjects x stimuli) bootstrap for inferential model comparison generalizing to new subjects and/or conditions; reports inflated false positives with <20 subjects and an n/(n-1) corrected bootstrap, subject-level t-test valid
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Donor/subject-population estimand, few-subject validity, paired model comparison with CV; neuroscience (RSA) not ST/pathology

title: Cross-validation: what does it estimate and how well does it do it?
one_line_what_it_does: Shows CV estimates average error over training sets, naive CV intervals under-cover because fold errors are correlated; nested CV for valid intervals; extension to differences between models only anticipated
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Folds-share-training-data problem and CI validity; i.i.d. rows, not clustered; difference between models not developed

title: Cross-validation confidence intervals for test error
one_line_what_it_does: CLTs and consistent variance estimators for k-fold and LOO CV; valid tests of whether one algorithm has smaller k-fold test error than another (stable algorithms)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: CV-based test for difference between two learners; i.i.d. data, asymptotic in n

title: The Relative Instability of Model Comparison with Cross-validation
one_line_what_it_does: Proves CV inference for model comparison can be invalid even for individually stable models (Lasso, soft-thresholding) when comparison is relatively unstable
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Warns that CV-based inference on encoder differences needs relative-stability check; no clusters

title: Constructing Confidence Intervals for 'the' Generalization Error - a Comprehensive Benchmark Study
authors: Schulz-Kumpel, Fischer, Hornung, Boulesteix, Nagler, Bischl
one_line_what_it_does: Compares 13 CI methods for generalization error (CV, bootstrap, nested CV, corrected t) on 19 tabular tasks; mlr3inferr package
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: CI coverage of resampling-based performance estimates; i.i.d., single model, no clusters

title: Statistical Uncertainty Quantification for Aggregate Performance Metrics in Machine Learning Benchmarks
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap and Bayesian hierarchical models for uncertainty in task-aggregated benchmark scores of foundation models (VTAB)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Multiplicity/aggregation across tasks; no donor clusters, no CV, no ST

title: Accounting for Variance in Machine Learning Benchmarks
one_line_what_it_does: Models benchmark variance sources (data sampling, init, HPO), proposes probability-of-outperforming criterion and bootstrap-based comparison
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Variance of ML comparisons incl. data-split variance; no clusters

title: Statistical comparison of classifiers through Bayesian hierarchical modelling
one_line_what_it_does: Hierarchical Bayesian model for CV results of two classifiers across many data sets with Nadeau-Bengio correlation, ROPE, shrinkage across data sets
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Multiple tasks + correlated CV folds in one model; datasets exchangeable, no donor level

title: Time for a Change: a Tutorial for Comparing Multiple Classifiers Through Bayesian Analysis
one_line_what_it_does: Tutorial: Bayesian correlated t-test, signed-rank test and hierarchical test replace NHST for classifier comparison
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Task-level multiplicity alternative

title: Should We Really Use Post-Hoc Tests Based on Mean-Ranks?
one_line_what_it_does: Shows Friedman mean-rank post-hoc results depend on the algorithm pool; recommends pairwise sign/Wilcoxon tests
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Multiplicity across tasks

title: Inference for the Generalization Error
one_line_what_it_does: Corrected resampled t-test accounting for overlap between training sets
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Classical CV-comparison correction (seen via Crossref record and citing papers only)

title: Quantifying Ranking Uncertainty in LLM Benchmarks
one_line_what_it_does: Rank confidence intervals from pairwise hypothesis tests; analyses sources of uncertainty in MMLU ranking
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Rank-level uncertainty for leaderboards; LLM

title: Cross-Validation for Correlated Data
one_line_what_it_does: Bias of K-fold CV under within-cluster correlation; bias-corrected CVc for linear models
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster-correlated data in CV point estimation, not inference on model differences

title: Internal-external cross-validation helped to evaluate the generalizability of prediction models in large clustered datasets
authors: Takada, Nijman, Denaxas, Snell, Uijl, Nguyen, Asselbergs, Debray
one_line_what_it_does: Leave-one-cluster-out validation, random-effects meta-analysis of performance across clusters and prediction intervals (clinical prediction)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster-level estimand for model performance over a population of clusters with few clusters; single/competing clinical models, no ST

title: Multivariate meta-analysis of individual participant data helped externally validate the performance and implementation of a prediction model
one_line_what_it_does: Joint random-effects meta-analysis of discrimination/calibration across studies within IECV, used to compare model implementation strategies across 12 studies
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Comparing competing models across few clusters with random-effects and prediction intervals

title: External validation of clinical prediction models using big datasets from e-health records or IPD meta-analysis
authors: Riley, Ensor, Snell, Debray et al.
one_line_what_it_does: Recommends per-cluster performance, random-effects MA, 95% prediction interval for performance in new cluster
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Donor-population estimand for performance

title: Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman approach and its modification for random-effects meta-analysis with few studies
one_line_what_it_does: Simulation of HKSJ/mKH CI coverage with few studies of unequal precision
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Few-cluster-valid intervals for a population mean

title: A Practitioner's Guide to Cluster-Robust Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Bias-corrected CRVE with T(G-1)/Bell-McCaffrey dof and wild cluster bootstrap for few clusters; pairs bootstrap poor for G<=10
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Few-cluster-valid intervals

title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference for Few Treated Clusters
authors: see QED working paper 1404 (authors not shown in retrieved text)
one_line_what_it_does: Discusses failure of CRVE t tests and wild cluster bootstrap with very few (treated) clusters; randomization-inference alternative
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Few-cluster reference distribution

title: Methods and open-source toolkit for analyzing and visualizing challenge results
authors: Wiesenfarth, Reinke, Landman, Eisenmann, Saiz, Cardoso, Maier-Hein, Kopp-Schneider
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap over test cases for ranking stability (blob/violin plots, Kendall tau) in biomedical image-analysis challenges, single- and multi-task
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Rank stability under sampling variability; resamples cases not clusters

title: Cross-validation failure: small sample sizes lead to large error bars
one_line_what_it_does: Shows across-fold SD strongly underestimates error bars of CV accuracy at small n
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Motivation: fold SD is not a valid error bar

title: Machine learning for medical imaging: methodological failures and recommendations for the future
one_line_what_it_does: Reviews evaluation failures: test sets too small, significance not tested; recommends CIs and several hundred test samples
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Motivation for power/sample-size part

title: K-fold cross-validation for complex sample surveys
authors: Wieczorek (co-authors not shown in retrieved text)
one_line_what_it_does: Design-weighted K-fold CV adapted to complex survey designs (cluster sampling)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Only design-based CV paper found; error estimation not model-difference inference

title: Training and Testing with Multiple Splits: A Central Limit Theorem for Split-Sample Estimators
one_line_what_it_does: CLT for multi-split estimators; normal CIs may undercover when comparing performance of two models
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Model-comparison CI failure under split reuse

title: Toward using confidence intervals to compare correlations
one_line_what_it_does: CI for the difference between dependent overlapping correlations (also cocor)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Per-gene Pearson differences within one donor (inner level only)

title: HEST-1k: A Dataset for Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology Image Analysis
one_line_what_it_does: Defines HEST-Benchmark: patient-stratified k-fold, mean Pearson over top-50 HVGs, SD across folds; no significance testing of encoder differences reported
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: The benchmark whose inference is at issue; error bars = SD across folds

title: STP-BENCH: A Unified Systematic Benchmark for Virtual Spatial Transcriptomics from Histopathology Images
one_line_what_it_does: 21 methods, >=15 slides/dataset 'for statistical reliability'; only Kruskal-Wallis across expression strata, no CIs/bootstrap/paired tests for model differences (full-text keyword scan)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Newest ST benchmark; confirms no donor-level inference for encoder comparisons

title: SpaFactor: Lightweight Spatial Context-Aware Gene Program Modeling for Histology-to-Transcriptomics Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Reports hierarchical paired bootstrap over datasets and folds for matched-control uncertainty
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Ad hoc practice of hierarchical bootstrap in an ST paper; no validity study

title: A benchmark study of vision and pathology foundation models for computational pathology
one_line_what_it_does: Pairwise statistical comparisons show differences among top pathology FMs are small and task dependent
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Pathology FM benchmark with significance testing, classification tasks, not ST/donor-cluster

title: Meta-encoder: a unified integration framework for multiple pathological foundation models in cancer detection
one_line_what_it_does: Tests encoder differences on HEST-Benchmark with one-sided Wilcoxon over n=450 gene-wise differences + FDR (genes as units)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Illustrates the pseudoreplicated practice a donor-level framework would correct

title: Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology (HERO)
one_line_what_it_does: Aggregates published HEST/THUNDER/eva/Patho-Bench ranks via Histoboard; no uncertainty on ranks
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Shows ranks are consumed without inference; notes HEST-Benchmark = 70 samples from 45 patients

title: PathBench: A comprehensive comparison benchmark for pathology foundation models towards precision oncology
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap CIs (10k replicates) and best-vs-rest tests per task for 19 PFMs
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Case-level bootstrap in slide-level tasks

title: Ensemble learning of pathology foundation models for precision oncology
one_line_what_it_does: Paired patient-level bootstrap for model differences, DeLong, Wilcoxon across tasks
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Typical paired patient-bootstrap practice, no few-cluster correction

title: Benchmarking Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer Survival Prediction
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap CIs show heavily overlapping intervals among 13 PFMs; mean-rank aggregation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Evidence that PFM differences are within noise; overlap-of-CI practice

title: Benchmarking the translational potential of spatial gene expression prediction from histology
one_line_what_it_does: Benchmark of 11 histology->ST methods on 2 small cohorts (8 and 4 patients); Wilcoxon rank-sum over genes
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Few-patient ST benchmark with gene-level tests

title: Completing Spatial Transcriptomics Data for Gene Expression Prediction Benchmarking (SpaRED)
one_line_what_it_does: Dunn test on MSE across models; most differences not significant
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Multi-dataset ST benchmark with nonparametric tests

title: Machine learning methods for finite population parameter estimation in survey sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Review of model-assisted and DML estimation under design-based inference
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Survey-sampling vocabulary for design-based estimand; not about benchmarks

title: The Emerging Science of Machine Learning Benchmarks
one_line_what_it_does: Book on ML benchmarks (seen via Crossref record only)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: General benchmark methodology
